baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلٌّ at word 2, جَمِيعٌ at word 4, and passive مُحْضَرُونَ at word 6 layer scope, collection, and caused presence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first term closes the set without remainder, the second joins its dispersed members, and the passive final term places the collected set in witnessed nearness at لَدَيْنَا. The result is an effected universal muster, not merely a prediction that everyone happens to be nearby.

activation_trace.role: Enclosure and completion give كُلٌّ a no-remainder scope over the entire set.
Joining what was dispersed makes جَمِيعٌ an operation of collection rather than a second loose universal.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity supply the endpoint, while the passive form marks that presence as caused.

changed_reading.before: Every individual will be present with Us.
changed_reading.after: No remainder stays outside: dispersed individuals are collected into one witnessed near-presence, and their presence is effected rather than self-initiated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three focus words support the encircling branch of ك ل ل, the binding branch of ج م ع, and the causative-motion branch of ح ض ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: An enclosing perimeter closes around the totality, a gathering bond makes the many one constrained body, and مُحْضَرُونَ conveys that body toward the endpoint لَدَيْنَا. This is branch-distant from the ordinary quantifier reading but remains attached to every rooted focus word.

activation_trace.role: The encircling image turns total scope into a perimeter from which no member exits.
The fetter that joins hands to neck supplies coercive cohesion to the gathered body.
The image of making a mount run or bringing it forward makes passive presentation a compelled conveyance.

changed_reading.after: All can be pictured as one enclosed and bound convoy, caused to move into Our presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَمِيعٌ at word 4 can name a gathering occasion, while مُحْضَرُونَ at word 6 can name attendance in contest before authority.
baseline_models.mechanism: The total set is summoned into a designated common forum; presence there is not neutral visibility but availability for claim, contest, and decision. كُلٌّ prevents anyone from escaping that common docket.

activation_trace.role: Complete enclosure makes the forum universal rather than selective.
A place, day, or call that gathers people supplies the common convening event.
Attendance in dispute and contest before a ruler turns presentation into an adjudicative appearance.

changed_reading.before: Everyone stands in the same place before Us.
changed_reading.after: Every party is convened on one universal docket and made available for adjudication before Us.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier neck-fetter posture gives bodily realization to the focus-only convoy model: restraint joins body parts, fixes orientation, and removes self-directed movement before the later universal passive presentation.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch already supplies a fetter that gathers hand to neck, ready for contextual activation.
Causative running or bringing supplies the compelled motion of those whose posture is constrained.
The literal neck locates the constraint on the body that will later be presented.
A collar that binds an organ makes collective restraint concrete rather than metaphorically vague.
The raised, averted head supplies the forced orientation of a body denied ordinary movement.

structural_cues: 36:8 places fetters in necks up to chins and ends with a passive bodily state, formally anticipating the passive plural مُحْضَرُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily restraint and the focus supplies universal caused presentation; I infer that the earlier constraint can pattern the later conveyance. A live alternative is that 36:8 depicts present refusal only and contributes no transport imagery to 36:32.

changed_reading.before: The compelled-convoy branches were a lexical possibility internal to the focus.
changed_reading.after: The surah has already staged neck-bound, forcibly oriented bodies, so universal presentation can retain a concrete undertone of constrained conveyance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gathered totality is record-resolved before it is spatially assembled: acts and continuing traces are written, every item is exhaustively counted, and the same no-remainder ك ل ل branch scopes the archive. Universal presence therefore functions as an exact roll call in which persons, deeds, and aftereffects remain addressable.

activation_trace.role: The focus totalizer makes the later muster coextensive with the earlier complete record.
Collection supplies the transition from separately registered entries to one assembled totality.
Entering a name in a register gives the muster an individuated roster rather than an anonymous crowd.
A surviving mark extends each person's record beyond immediate acts to effects left behind.
The repeated totalizer explicitly closes the archive over every thing.
Counting with exhaustive investigation supplies the archive's no-loss precision.

structural_cues: 36:12 sequences reviving the dead, writing what they sent ahead and their traces, and enumerating every thing before 36:32 announces universal presentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete register and a complete muster; I infer that the register functions as the muster's identity-and-account manifest. It could instead be evidence used only after assembly, without organizing how the assembly is conceived.

changed_reading.before: All persons are gathered without omission.
changed_reading.after: All are called into presence as individually traceable entries of an exhaustive archive, carrying both their acts and their continuing effects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes failed horizontal return from unavoidable return to the divine endpoint. Destroyed cohorts do not come back to later people, yet persons are returned to their maker; كُلٌّ and جَمِيعٌ then collect those non-overlapping generations across time.

activation_trace.role: Complete scope stretches the set across generations rather than limiting it to one living crowd.
A gathering of peoples and mixtures permits historically separate cohorts to coexist in one assembly.
Return to what one came from establishes the divine-directed endpoint before the focus.
Falling into destruction creates the historical absence that ordinary return cannot undo.
People conjoined in one era supply the distinct chronological cohorts later collected together.
The denied return to later people sharpens the contrast with being returned to the divine presence.

structural_cues: 36:31's destination is إِلَيْهِمْ, whereas 36:22's destination is إِلَيْهِ and 36:32's endpoint is لَدَيْنَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destroyed generations and contrasting destinations of return; I infer that 36:32 resolves the contrast by gathering every era at the divine endpoint. Another reading may treat 36:31 only as irreversible worldly death and leave diachronic assembly implicit.

changed_reading.before: A contemporaneous universal crowd is brought before Us.
changed_reading.after: Historically disjoint generations that never return to one another are all redirected into one divine-directed return and presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single acoustic impulse reverses repose: breath enters the horn, graves open as points of departure, sleepers are stirred, and they rush toward their Lord. The exact جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ recurrence then identifies the focus presentation as the endpoint of this rapid mobilization.

activation_trace.role: The focus image of causing a mount to run becomes an eventive transport reading when the later sequence supplies rushing bodies.
Sending wind into something supplies the initiating impulse of the mobilization.
The blowing horn gives that impulse a concrete instrument.
The grave supplies the stationary enclosure from which each member departs.
Rapid forward motion turns presentation from static attendance into a rushing convergence.
Stirring what was motionless provides the reversal that starts bodily movement.
Sleep and stillness define the prior state abrogated by the blast.
The terrifying cry compresses the causal trigger into one decisive event.
Union in one direction lets a single impulse coordinate the whole dispersed population.
The repeated focus inventory branch resolves the rushing streams as one collected body.
The repeated caused presence names the completed endpoint of the blast-to-grave-to-rush sequence.

structural_cues: 36:51-53 forms an explicit sequence from horn blast, through emergence from graves and rapid movement, to the near-verbatim focus clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every link of the sequence; I infer that the recurrence at 36:53 retroactively supplies 36:32's event mechanics. The alternative is to read 36:32 as a general thesis and 36:53 as only one later instantiation.

changed_reading.before: All are statically assembled in divine presence.
changed_reading.after: One impulse synchronously reverses repose, drives emergence from graves, and converges the rushing multitude into caused presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal collection is a temporary common docket, not permanent homogenization. Once all are present, acts receive matching recompense, one class is separated, mouths are sealed, and hands speak while feet witness; bodily presence becomes an evidence system.

activation_trace.role: A mixed gathered body permits common assembly without erasing the classes later distinguished within it.
Attendance in contest before authority supplies the adjudicative function of being made present.
Matching an act with its recompense makes the universal appearance consequential and discriminating.
Intended action supplies the object against which each present person is assessed.
Sorting until one thing is clear from another makes differentiation follow, rather than contradict, total gathering.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers turns the hand into an evidentiary voice.
The branch of what hands have earned joins the speaking organ directly to the deeds under review.
Presence together with witnessing fuses bodily attendance to testimony.
The branch of acquiring organs makes the body that acted become the body that evidences acquisition.

structural_cues: 36:54 begins with 'so today,' 36:59 commands separation on that day, and 36:65 stages organ-by-organ testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, sorting, speech, and witness after universal presence; I infer a docket-to-verdict mechanism. These scenes could instead be successive proclamations with no procedural courtroom model.

changed_reading.before: All are gathered as one undifferentiated multitude.
changed_reading.after: All first enter one universal docket, then are sorted and individually evidenced by the very bodies through which their deeds were acquired.

context_deltas.mechanism: The object gathered is not necessarily an already intact traveler. Human formation from fluid, the decay of bones, originating creation, and the command that makes a thing be together activate ج م ع as re-cohering dispersed material and ح ض ر as bringing a person back into manifest embodied presence.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed parts into a collected thing supplies the reconstitution mechanism.
Caused presence turns successful reconstitution into a manifest person at the divine endpoint.
Clear fluid spanning scales from drop to sea supplies a minimal material origin for a full person.
The hard bone supplies the body's apparently durable component now exposed to decay.
Worn-out decay supplies the disintegrated state from which collection would have to recover a person.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies the capacity that reverses material disintegration.
An obligating command supplies the directional cause from intention to realized being.
Occurrence and presence in time make the commanded transition terminate in actual being.

structural_cues: 36:77-82 moves from first human formation, through decayed bones, to renewed origination and immediate commanded being.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material origin, decay, renewed creation, and effected being; I infer that universal presentation includes re-cohering persons, not only transporting them. A live alternative is equivalent new embodiment without retrieval of the same dispersed matter.

changed_reading.before: Already constituted persons are transported into one place.
changed_reading.after: Disintegrated persons are first re-cohered into manifest embodiment and only thereby become the complete gathered totality in divine presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse recasts لَدَيْنَا as jurisdiction rather than mere location: every thing lies within hand-held dominion and is returned to its possessor. The universal muster is therefore a transfer into inescapable sovereign custody.

activation_trace.role: Complete scope makes custody universal.
Appearance before a ruler supplies the jurisdictional force of being made present.
The hand as authority turns proximity 'with Us' into sovereign reach.
Dominion and sovereignty identify whose jurisdiction contains the totality.
The repeated complete totalizer extends dominion over every thing without remainder.
Return to what one came from supplies the final movement into that sovereign reach.

structural_cues: The surah closes by placing the dominion of every thing in His hand and directing the audience's return to Him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hand, dominion, totality, and return; I infer that لَدَيْنَا denotes custody under authority as well as nearness. The hand image may instead stress creative power without a specifically juridical notion of custody.

changed_reading.before: All arrive at a divine location.
changed_reading.after: Every being is returned inside the sovereign reach that already possesses all things, so presence is universal custody as well as proximity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Treat this as a transport analogy, not a claim that the focus names a literal ship. It is surprising because it maps eschatological gathering onto cargo and lineage, but it remains anchored in جَمِيعٌ as a mixed collected body and مُحْضَرُونَ as caused conveyance; downstream prose should mark it as an imagistic whole-surah activation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَمِيعٌ at word 4 gathers mixed persons, while passive مُحْضَرُونَ at word 6 can carry the causative movement of a transported collective.

activation_trace.role: A gathered mixture supplies the human manifest carried together.
Causing a mount to run supplies the conveyance from carriage to endpoint.
Bearing a visible load makes collective transport the operative analogy.
Small dispersed particles activate lineage as posterity spread across time and then carried together.
The ship supplies the common carrier that holds the dispersed lineage.
Filling a vessel turns 'all' into a complete manifest with no empty allotment.

changed_reading.before: Individuals independently arrive and then form a crowd.
changed_reading.after: The whole lineage can be imagined as one fully laden manifest, carried together across the divide into divine presence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a material analogy rather than lexical equivalence. It is surprising because fire from green wood is mapped onto persons emerging from death, but it remains anchored in ح ض ر as caused manifestation and ج م ع as collecting what was not visibly present; downstream prose should retain 'as if' or 'analogically' and not identify bodies with fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُحْضَرُونَ at word 6 can denote being caused into manifest proximity, and جَمِيعٌ at word 4 supplies the collecting operation.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed elements supplies the hidden-to-coherent side of the analogy.
Caused presence supplies the emergence of a previously unmanifest result.
The living tree supplies the apparently contrary material substrate.
Fresh green vegetation sharpens the material contrast with ignition.
Burning fire supplies the latent result made suddenly manifest.
Ignition supplies the transition from concealed potential to visible event.

changed_reading.before: Presentation is movement of visible persons into a visible forum.
changed_reading.after: Analogically, universal presentation is extraction into manifest form from a condition that appears to contain its opposite, as fire is kindled from green wood.

strongest_changes: The exact 36:53 recurrence turns 36:32 from static attendance into the endpoint of a one-blast, grave-to-rush mobilization.
The archive of 36:12 and the testimony sequence of 36:54-65 make universal gathering an exact, sortable, evidentiary roll call.
The creation sequence of 36:77-83 expands gathering from transport into reconstitution followed by return into sovereign custody.
summary.what_was_special: The focus doubles totalization with كُلٌّ and جَمِيعٌ, then uses passive مُحْضَرُونَ; the whole surah repeatedly supplies mechanisms for what is totalized, how it is mobilized, why it is presented, and under whose authority it arrives without displacing those three anchors.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the neck-fetter imagery of 36:8 should carry into the mechanics of final presentation or remain limited to present refusal.
Whether renewed embodiment retrieves dispersed prior matter or creates an equivalent body anew.
Whether the adjudicative forum is the meaning of caused presence or a consequence that follows it.
